title: Why Cholesterol Is High Even If You Eat Well and Exercise
description: Up to 30% of adults with healthy habits have genetic high cholesterol—like FH—where LDL stays >190 despite diet. Find out if you should test.

title: Cholesterol and Chest Pain: Can High Levels Cause Symptoms?
description: Only 7% of people with high cholesterol report chest pain before a heart event—but 41% had unexplained fatigue first. Discover early signs.

title: Does Lipoprotein(a) Test Matter If Parent Had Heart Attack at 40?
